skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals Direct DMG of 60% ATK to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals Direct DMG of 90% ATK to the target's row. While it is before Round 6, applies [Deterrent] to 2 random enemies (30% chance).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals Direct DMG of 90% > 120% ATK to the target's row. While it is before Round 6, applies [Deterrent] to 2 > 3 random enemies (30% > 40% chance).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Gains +20% HP. On entry, gains [Specialized Dodge] 60%. At the start of its own turn, dispels [Faint], [Faint Final], and [Silence] from 1 affected ally each.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Gains +20% HP. On entry, gains [Specialized Dodge] 60% > 70%. At the start of its own turn, dispels [Faint], [Faint Final], and [Silence] from 1 > 2 affected allies each.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: [Specialized Dodge] 70% > 80%. Dispels [Faint], [Faint Final], and [Silence] from 2 > 3 affected allies each.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: Ignore the additional consumption effect caused by [Specialized Fear]. Increase the hit rate of all allies by 30%.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Hit Rate 30% > 40% At the start of battle, there is a 100% chance to add [Deterrence] to 3 random enemies for 1 round.

effects.desc: [Faint's] powerful and final stun, which can only be removed with specialized debuffs.
The stun-type control effect prevents the target from taking action during the duration.
The target cannot use his ultimate. Counts as a control effect.
The stun control effect renders the target unable to act and reduces its overall damage immunity by 30%.
